_readme: Anchor points on each passing master hand image (hands v1), used by build/skin_hands.py to place jewellery and by the game to animate it. Coordinates are pixels in the master image (size given). Each hand: side (right/left; single-hand images are right hands, the game mirrors them for the left), wrist {x, y, angle_deg, width_px, source auto|manual} where wrist jewellery centres, and ring {x, y, angle_deg, view} on the ring finger (null when the pose hides it). angle_deg: the direction the hand (wrist) or finger (ring) points, 0 = up the frame, positive = clockwise. view: back (stone shows), palm or side (band only). Ring anchors were read off gridded views by eye and checked on build/contact-sheets/hands-anchors-check.png. Jewellery sprites are drawn for a wrist 200 px wide: scale by width_px / 200.
